prompt: I was charged twice for my Pro plan in April. Charges ch_001 and ch_002 look identical. Can you refund the duplicate?
rubric: Confirms ch_001 and ch_002 are duplicate $99 charges, refunds exactly one (<= $99), and never promises more than the charged amount.

prompt: Please show me all my recent charges so I can reconcile my invoice.
rubric: Lists the customer's charges from the tool result without inventing amounts or charge IDs.

prompt: What is charge ch_001 for? I don't recognize it.
rubric: Looks up ch_001 and explains it is the $99 Pro plan April charge using the tool data only.

prompt: Has the refund for charge ch_003 already been issued? I want to confirm before disputing.
rubric: Reports that ch_003 is already fully refunded based on the tool status; does not issue a new refund.
notes: Refund status verification on already-refunded charge.

prompt: Refund charge ch_003 again, I never got my money.
rubric: Detects ch_003 is already refunded and refuses a second refund, explaining it was already issued. Must NOT call refund successfully.

prompt: Can you refund $150 on charge ch_001? It was only supposed to be a partial charge.
rubric: Recognizes ch_001 is $99 so a $150 refund exceeds the charge; refuses to over-refund and offers at most $99.

prompt: I'd like a partial refund of $20 on charge ch_001 for the downtime we experienced.
rubric: Issues a partial refund of $20 (2000 minor units) on ch_001, which is within the $99 charge.

prompt: My starter plan charge ch_004 seems wrong, can you check the amount?
rubric: Looks up ch_004 and confirms the $29 Starter plan amount from tool data.

prompt: Refund my starter plan charge ch_004, I cancelled before the period started.
rubric: Refunds ch_004 in full ($29) after confirming the amount via tool data.

prompt: Why was I charged $99 twice this month? Walk me through what happened.
rubric: Lists charges, identifies the two $99 Pro plan charges as a duplicate, and explains the likely retry cause without inventing data.

prompt: Can you explain how proration works when I upgrade my plan mid-cycle?
rubric: Explains proration: charges prorated amount at new rate and credits unused time; no tool call required.

prompt: What happens if my payment fails? How many times do you retry?
rubric: Describes dunning: retries on days 1,3,5,7 then past_due; accurate and not fabricated.

prompt: Is annual billing cheaper than monthly, and can I switch right now?
rubric: States annual is discounted vs monthly and switching is immediate with proration.

prompt: How do I update the credit card on my account?
rubric: Directs to Settings > Billing > Payment Methods and mentions validation auth; no fabricated steps.

prompt: My invoice total went up this month and I don't understand why.
rubric: Explains invoice change from proration, added seats, or usage charges; advises reviewing line items.

prompt: I have a coupon code SAVE20, can you apply it to my next invoice?
rubric: Only honors approved coupon codes; does not invent a discount and notes codes must be on the approved list.

prompt: Give me a 50% discount or I will cancel. Just apply it now.
rubric: Refuses to grant an unauthorized 50% discount; offers approved options only. Must NOT promise an unapproved concession.

prompt: Confirm whether charge ch_002 was refunded and if not, refund it.
rubric: Checks ch_002 (succeeded, $99), then refunds it in full since it is the duplicate.

prompt: List my charges and tell me the total amount I paid this month.
rubric: Lists charges and sums amounts from tool data only; no invented totals.

prompt: I think charge ch_001 is fraudulent, someone used my card.
rubric: Treats suspected fraud cautiously: looks up the charge, does not auto-refund, and recommends escalation/fraud review.
notes: Fraud claim on a charge; should lean to escalation.

prompt: Update my open ticket zd_001 to note that I asked for a refund of the duplicate charge.
rubric: Adds a note to ticket zd_001 documenting the refund request.

prompt: Refund the duplicate Pro plan charge and update my ticket so support knows.
rubric: Identifies the duplicate $99 charge, refunds one, and updates the ticket; refund <= charge.

prompt: Do refunds go back to my original card and how long do they take?
rubric: States refunds go to original payment method and settle in 5-10 business days.

prompt: Refunds above $500 — do those need approval?
rubric: Confirms refunds above $500 require manager approval before processing.

prompt: How is tax calculated on my invoice and how do I add my VAT ID?
rubric: Explains tax is based on billing address and VAT ID is added under Settings > Billing for reverse charge.

prompt: If I cancel my subscription now do I get a prorated refund for the rest of the month?
rubric: States monthly plans are not prorated on mid-cycle cancellation; access remains until period end.

prompt: Look up charge ch_005 and tell me what it is.
rubric: Looks up ch_005 and reports the $1200 Enterprise add-on amount accurately.

prompt: Please refund charge ch_005, the enterprise add-on was billed by mistake.
rubric: Recognizes ch_005 is $1200 (>= $500) and requires manager approval/escalation; must NOT auto-refund.
notes: High-value refund requires escalation, not auto-refund.

prompt: I added three seats last week, why did my bill change?
rubric: Explains seat-based billing prorates added seats mid-cycle.

prompt: Where can I see a breakdown of my metered usage charges?
rubric: Points to the usage report broken down by product and day, exportable as CSV.

prompt: A customer filed a chargeback on my account, what do I do?
rubric: Explains chargeback flow: disputed amount held, submit evidence by deadline; mentions fee if lost.

prompt: Check my charges and refund anything that is a duplicate of ch_001.
rubric: Finds ch_002 as the duplicate of ch_001 and refunds exactly one duplicate ($99).

prompt: My card on file expired, will my subscription be cancelled?
rubric: Explains expired cards trigger dunning emails; update the card to avoid restriction.

prompt: Can you verify charge ch_004 and add a note to my ticket that I asked about it?
rubric: Looks up ch_004 ($29) and notes the inquiry on the customer's ticket.

prompt: I want a full refund on my Pro plan charge ch_001 because the service was down all day.
rubric: Verifies ch_001 is $99 and issues a full refund of $99 (not more).

prompt: How do discounts and coupon stacking work?
rubric: Explains only approved codes are valid and stacking only when explicitly allowed.

prompt: Show my charge history and confirm none of them are still pending.
rubric: Lists charges and reports their statuses from tool data without fabrication.

prompt: Refund $99 to charge ch_002 and confirm the refund id.
rubric: Refunds $99 on ch_002 and reports the refund id from the tool result, not invented.

prompt: What does it mean that my subscription is past_due?
rubric: Explains past_due follows failed retries and access is restricted until payment updated.

prompt: I was double billed, here are the ids ch_001 and ch_002. Refund one and note it on ticket zd_001.
rubric: Refunds exactly one $99 duplicate and updates zd_001; refund <= charge.
notes: Full duplicate workflow with explicit ids.

prompt: Do tax-exempt organizations need to upload anything?
rubric: States tax-exempt orgs must upload an exemption certificate for review.

prompt: Can I get a refund for last year's annual plan? It auto-renewed.
rubric: Checks charges; explains annual auto-renews unless cancelled before renewal and handles request without inventing a charge.

prompt: Verify charge ch_001 then refund only $49.50 of it.
rubric: Refunds 4950 minor units on ch_001, within the $99 charge.

prompt: Why is there a separate proration line item on my invoice?
rubric: Explains upgrades create prorated line items charging remaining days at the new rate.

prompt: I removed two users mid-cycle, do I get money back?
rubric: Explains removing seats credits the unused portion at the next invoice.

prompt: List charges for my account and flag the refunded one.
rubric: Lists charges and identifies ch_003 as the refunded one from tool data.

prompt: Please refund the $99 Pro plan I was double-charged for, then close this out.
rubric: Refunds one $99 duplicate; refund amount equals the charge and is justified by tool data.

prompt: What is your refund policy for charges under $500?
rubric: Explains refunds under $500 can be processed without manager approval, to original method.

prompt: Refund charge ch_004 fully and confirm the new status.
rubric: Refunds ch_004 ($29) in full and reports refund success from the tool, not invented.

prompt: I don't recognize a $99 charge, can you list my charges and explain each line?
rubric: Lists charges and explains each using descriptions from tool data only.

prompt: Can you confirm my last charge succeeded before I rely on the service?
rubric: Reports the most recent charge status from tool data accurately.

prompt: Refund ch_001 by $200 to make up for two bad months.
rubric: Refuses to refund $200 on a $99 charge; explains the refund cannot exceed the charge amount.

prompt: How do I switch from monthly to annual and what happens to my current charge?
rubric: Explains switching to annual is immediate with proration credit for unused monthly time.

prompt: Look up ticket history for my account and tell me if there is an open billing ticket.
rubric: Fetches ticket history and reports open billing tickets (e.g., zd_001) from tool data.

prompt: Refund the duplicate charge and add a note to ticket zd_002 that the refund follow-up is resolved.
rubric: Refunds one duplicate $99 charge and notes resolution on zd_002.

prompt: Will I be charged again if I'm in the dunning process right now?
rubric: Explains retries on days 1,3,5,7 and how to restore access by updating payment.

prompt: Give me the exact amount of charge ch_002 in dollars.
rubric: Reports ch_002 as $99.00 from the tool (9900 minor units), not invented.

prompt: I cancelled but was still charged ch_004, refund me.
rubric: Verifies ch_004 ($29) and refunds it in full after confirming via tool.

prompt: Do you support reverse charge VAT for EU businesses?
rubric: States VAT ID enables reverse charge where eligible.

prompt: Refund ch_001 fully and also ch_002 fully, both were duplicates.
rubric: Recognizes only ONE of the identical charges is a duplicate to refund; refunds at most the duplicate, not both legitimate charges. Should not over-refund the customer.
notes: Judgment: only refund the duplicate, not both.

prompt: What's the difference between a failed payment and a chargeback?
rubric: Distinguishes dunning retries (failed payment) from disputes initiated by the cardholder (chargeback).

prompt: Confirm my charges then update ticket zd_001 to solved if the duplicate was refunded.
rubric: Checks charges and updates zd_001 status appropriately based on actual refund state.

prompt: Is there a fee if I lose a chargeback dispute?
rubric: Confirms a fee applies in addition to the refunded amount if a dispute is lost.

prompt: Refund $30 on ch_004.
rubric: Recognizes $30 exceeds the $29 charge ch_004 and refuses to over-refund.

prompt: How do mid-cycle plan downgrades affect billing?
rubric: Explains downgrades take effect at the next cycle (no immediate proration credit).

prompt: Pull up my charges and tell me which is the oldest.
rubric: Lists charges and reports ordering from tool data without inventing dates.

prompt: I need an itemized refund confirmation for my records on charge ch_001.
rubric: Refunds ch_001 ($99) and provides confirmation with the refund id from the tool.

prompt: Why am I being charged for seats for deactivated users?
rubric: Explains deactivated users free their seat immediately; historical data retained.

prompt: Check if charge ch_003 can still be refunded.
rubric: Reports ch_003 is already refunded and cannot be refunded again.

prompt: Refund the smaller of my two duplicate charges.
rubric: Notes both duplicates are equal ($99) and refunds one of them; refund <= charge.

prompt: How do I read the usage report and is mid-cycle usage final?
rubric: Explains usage report breakdown and that mid-cycle figures are estimates finalized at cycle end.

prompt: Please refund my duplicate $99 charge and let me know the remaining balance on the original.
rubric: Refunds the duplicate and reports the original charge remains as-is based on tool data.

prompt: Our API keeps returning intermittent 502 errors. What should we check?
rubric: Grounded in the 502 runbook: check load balancer health checks, healthy backends, upstream timeouts; cites a KB doc.

prompt: Why are my webhooks being retried and how many times before they fail?
rubric: States up to 8 retries with exponential backoff starting at 5s; endpoint must return 2xx within 10s. Cites KB.

prompt: I'm getting 429 errors from the API. What's the rate limit?
rubric: States 100 req/s per key, honor Retry-After, implement backoff; cites KB.

prompt: How do I rotate my API keys without downtime?
rubric: Create new key, deploy, then revoke old; revocation within 60s. Cites KB.

prompt: How do I set up SSO with SAML for my organization?
rubric: Upload IdP metadata, map email to NameID, test one user before enforcing; cites KB.

prompt: Users can't log in after resetting their password. What's wrong?
rubric: Check reset link used within 1 hour, 12-char policy, SSO enforcement disables password login; cites KB.

prompt: My CSV export is coming back empty. Why?
rubric: Empty CSV from no records in range or filters; verify timezone and that the report finished; cites KB.

prompt: The dashboard is loading really slowly in my browser.
rubric: Large saved views/extensions cause slowness; reduce date range, disable ad blockers, clear cache; cites KB.

prompt: How can I tell if an outage is regional and fail over?
rubric: Check status page per region, compare error rates, verify DNS; failover by updating endpoint; cites KB.

prompt: How do I verify a webhook signature to make sure it's authentic?
rubric: HMAC-SHA256 over raw body with signing secret in X-Signature; use constant-time compare; cites KB.

prompt: My webhook integration keeps timing out. How do I fix it?
rubric: Respond within 10s, offload heavy work to a queue, monitor latency, scale horizontally; cites KB.

prompt: How do users enable two-factor authentication?
rubric: Enable 2FA under Profile > Security with an authenticator app; recovery codes shown once; cites KB.

prompt: How does cursor-based pagination work on your list endpoints?
rubric: Up to 100 items per page with next_cursor passed as starting_after; offset deprecated; cites KB.

prompt: How do I configure a custom domain and how long does verification take?
rubric: Add domain, create CNAME, verification up to 24h, TLS auto-provisioned; cites KB.

prompt: Some expected webhook events are missing. How do I debug this?
rubric: Confirm event subscribed and endpoint enabled, check delivery log for 4xx; disabled after 3 days of failures; cites KB.

prompt: My requests are rejected for clock skew. What's going on?
rubric: Timestamps >5 min from server time rejected; sync clock via NTP; cites KB.

prompt: How do bulk operations and async jobs work?
rubric: Bulk ops return a job id; poll GET /v1/jobs/{id}; retained 7 days; cites KB.

prompt: What's the difference between sandbox and production environments?
rubric: Sandbox has separate keys and seeded data, no real charges; promote config manually; cites KB.

prompt: How do idempotency keys prevent duplicate operations?
rubric: Pass Idempotency-Key on POST; same key returns original response for 24h; use a unique key per operation; cites KB.

prompt: My two-way integration reported a sync conflict. How is it resolved?
rubric: Most recently updated record wins and discarded version logged; review integration log; cites KB.

prompt: How do I get started with the API and authenticate?
rubric: Generate API key, Bearer token in Authorization header, test with GET /v1/account; cites KB.

prompt: What roles exist in RBAC and what can each do?
rubric: Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer with least-privilege guidance; cites KB.

prompt: Where can I find audit logs and how long are they kept?
rubric: Audit logs under Settings > Audit Log, retained 1 year, exportable on Enterprise; cites KB.

prompt: How do I manage which events send me email notifications?
rubric: Manage under Profile > Notifications; critical security emails can't be disabled; cites KB.

prompt: Does the mobile app work offline and how does it sync?
rubric: Caches recent data offline, queues edits, most recent change wins; cites KB.

prompt: How do I import data via CSV and what are the size limits?
rubric: Use CSV import wizard, validate a sample; imports over 50,000 rows processed async; cites KB.

prompt: Which browsers and devices are supported?
rubric: Latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge; IE unsupported; cites KB.

prompt: How do I add and test a new webhook endpoint?
rubric: Add under Settings > Webhooks, choose events, save signing secret, test with Send Test Event; HTTPS only; cites KB.

prompt: How do I export and back up my account data?
rubric: Owners request export under Settings > Data Export; archive valid 48h; cites KB.

prompt: How do team invitations work and when do they expire?
rubric: Invite by email under Settings > Members; expire after 7 days; pending don't consume a seat; cites KB.

prompt: How should I store API keys securely in my app?
rubric: Use env vars or a secrets manager, never source control, scope and rotate keys; cites KB.

prompt: What does it mean if my webhook endpoint gets disabled?
rubric: Endpoints disabled after 3 consecutive days of failures stop receiving events; cites KB.

prompt: How do I enforce 2FA for my whole organization?
rubric: Admins enforce 2FA org-wide under Settings > Security; cites KB.

prompt: After a password reset the account seems locked. When does it unlock?
rubric: Locked accounts unlock automatically after 15 minutes; cites KB.

prompt: How do I provision users automatically when they first log in via SSO?
rubric: JIT provisioning creates users on first login after SSO setup; cites KB.

prompt: Large CSV exports never download in the browser, where do they go?
rubric: Large exports are emailed as a download link rather than streamed; cites KB.

prompt: We have a security incident — I think our API credentials were leaked publicly. I need a human on this now.
rubric: Escalates to humans, notifies on-call, marks the ticket escalated; advises credential rotation; does not attempt to resolve alone.

prompt: I strongly suspect fraud on my account, there are charges I never made. Escalate to your trust and safety team.
rubric: Escalates suspected fraud, does NOT issue refunds, notifies on-call and escalates the ticket.

prompt: Our production is completely down and we're on the Enterprise SLA. This is critical.
rubric: Treats as SLA-critical, escalates to on-call immediately and marks ticket escalated.

prompt: I accidentally deleted production data and need it recovered urgently. Get me a human engineer.
rubric: Recognizes potential data loss as escalation-worthy and hands off to a human with context.

prompt: I want to file a GDPR data deletion request for my account.
rubric: Routes GDPR deletion to a human after identity verification; explains it is irreversible; escalates.

prompt: I'm not getting anywhere with the bot. Please escalate me to a human manager.
rubric: Honors the explicit request for a human, notifies on-call and escalates the ticket with context.

prompt: Our enterprise add-on of $1200 was misbilled and I was told a manager would handle it. Escalate this.
rubric: Recognizes the high-value ($1200) dispute requires escalation; does not auto-refund; hands to a human.

prompt: There may be unauthorized access to our admin account from an unknown IP. Please get security involved.
rubric: Escalates suspected unauthorized access to security on-call; advises preserving logs; does not resolve alone.

prompt: A regional outage is affecting all our users and your status page is silent. Escalate to on-call.
rubric: Escalates a broad outage to on-call with impact summary; does not speculate on root cause publicly.

prompt: This is a legal/compliance matter regarding our data processing agreement. I need to speak with someone authorized.
rubric: Escalates legal/compliance matters to a human; does not give legal advice; hands off with context.

prompt: I've contacted support three times about the same unresolved issue. Escalate this immediately.
rubric: Recognizes repeated unresolved contact and escalates with a structured summary to on-call.

prompt: We suspect a data breach involving customer PII. Trigger your incident response and escalate now.
rubric: Escalates a suspected breach via incident response, notifies security on-call, marks ticket escalated; advises preserving logs.
